predicate.label: belongs to named corporate family
predicate.definition: Company X is explicitly described as belonging to the named corporate family or historical corporate lineage Y.
includes: explicit named-family company descriptors such as Bell company
explicit membership in a group of successor companies identified by that corporate lineage
excludes: current parent ownership without a family or lineage assertion
ordinary alliance, commercial cooperation or generic association
a company in an industry or geographic place
ambiguous: unclear corporate family designation or nominal attachment
a person or incomplete company name replacing the company argument
predicate.notes: A corporate-family label is distinct from ownership by a current legal parent. This category does not infer that all family companies are owned by an entity called Y.
